change.successor_heartbeat_rule: observed available RAM below 6 GiB at any scheduler launch or refill heartbeat stops the run before further scheduling or interpretation; exactly 6 GiB passes; an already in-flight worker is governed by the unchanged 4 GiB emergency runtime floor

applies_to: Stage B translation-depth oracle plus object-approach execution
any future unconsumed RCLE_PERIODIC_SELF_MOTION_COUNTERFACTUAL_R2 workload that previously inherited the 8 GiB launch or refill guard
scope.future_entrypoint_rule: A future execution may not claim current authority from a historical 8 GiB-bound entrypoint alone; it must bind this amendment and enforce the 6 GiB launch/refill guard.

validation.mutation_requirement: A runner or receipt that restores 8 GiB as the current launch/refill requirement, accepts a launch/refill heartbeat below 6 GiB, lowers 6 GiB without a new amendment, rejects exactly 6 GiB, or omits the 4 GiB in-flight emergency floor must fail independent validation.
